title: Dynamic Todo List
description: Build a todo list with add/remove functionality using v-for, v-model, and conditional rendering.
problemStatement:
## Problem Statement

Create a Vue app that manages a todo list. The app should have:

- An input field where the user can type a new todo (use `v-model`).
- An "Add Todo" button that adds the current input to the list (if not empty).
- A list of todos displayed with `v-for`. Each todo should have a checkbox to mark it as completed and a "Delete" button.
- Completed todos should have a strikethrough style.
- Show a message if the list is empty (using `v-if`).

**Bonus**: Add a filter (All, Active, Completed) to show only the relevant todos.

Use CDN setup. Ensure each todo has a unique `id` for the `:key`.
hints: Store todos as an array of objects: `{ id: Date.now(), text: '', completed: false }`.
Use `v-model` for the input and checkbox.
For strikethrough, use `:class` with an object: `:class="{ completed: todo.completed }"`.
To add a todo, push a new object to the array and clear the input.
To delete, filter out the todo by id.
expectedOutput: A working todo list app with add, delete, and mark completed functionality.
